dedupe_keys.name: optimised biowaste collection calendars for meetjesland flanders data and results

description: This repository holds the input data and detailed results behind a study that redesigned biowaste collection for the intermunicipal household waste association of Meetjesland (IVM) in East Flanders, Belgium. It was deposited on figshare in August 2026 by Jeroen Beliën, Simon De Jaeger, Hendrik Vermuyten and Carolien Lavigne. New European rules obliged IVM to change how it collects biowaste, and the association lacked figures on the cost and environmental impact of the options. The authors built a mixed integer linear programming model to optimise and compare many collection calendars, with and without a transfer station, and estimated key performance indicators that were discussed with the member municipalities; the association then introduced a new transfer station and new collection calendars. Coverage is the Meetjesland region. The files, about 0.7 MB, are free to download under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: the record describes one region's data and scenarios, the file list and formats should be checked on figshare, and the model code is not described as part of the deposit. Simulation uses: collection demand and scenario data for waste collection routing and facility location models. Related records: the Bahía Blanca routing instances (data-bahia-blanca-waste-collection-routing-instances) and the capacitated waste collection routing data (data-capacitated-waste-collection-routing-p02999) are other collection benchmarks.
